verdict.rationale: Jan documents a built-in, OpenAI-compatible API server at localhost:1337 that other applications can call. It is pitched as a drop-in replacement for cloud APIs, and a documented option binds it to 0.0.0.0 so other devices on the local network can reach it. That covers the core of driving the product programmatically. Missing for 10: evidence that the API covers app functions beyond inference (assistants, projects, model downloads); a published OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, since the probes for openapi.json and llms.txt returned 404; and independent or hands-on confirmation of the API's use.
